LaTeX Equation of a Fitted Model

Source: R/methods.reli_htest.R, R/methods.simple_mconv.R, R/methods.simple_mvc.R, and 3 more
model_equation.Rd

Writes the statistical model behind a result as a LaTeX equation: the mean model, the distributions of the random effects and residuals, and any variance function or correlation structure. The equation uses symbols by default; with use_coefs = TRUE the estimates are substituted.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'reli_htest'
model_equation(x, use_coefs = FALSE, coef_digits = 3, ...)

# S3 method for class 'simple_mconv'
model_equation(x, use_coefs = FALSE, coef_digits = 3, pair = NULL, ...)

# S3 method for class 'simple_mvc'
model_equation(x, use_coefs = FALSE, coef_digits = 3, ...)

# S3 method for class 'simple_reli'
model_equation(x, use_coefs = FALSE, coef_digits = 3, ...)

# S3 method for class 'tolerance_delta'
model_equation(x, use_coefs = FALSE, coef_digits = 3, ...)

model_equation(x, ...)

# Default S3 method
model_equation(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'lm'
model_equation(x, use_coefs = FALSE, coef_digits = 3, ...)

# S3 method for class 'lmerMod'
model_equation(x, use_coefs = FALSE, coef_digits = 3, ...)

# S3 method for class 'gls'
model_equation(x, use_coefs = FALSE, coef_digits = 3, ...)

# S3 method for class 'lme'
model_equation(x, use_coefs = FALSE, coef_digits = 3, ...)

# S3 method for class 'model_equation'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A result of tolerance_limit(), icc_test(), reli_err_test(), mdc_test(), reli_facet_test(), reli_stats(), reli_aov(), method_vc() or method_convert(), or a model fitted with stats::lm(), lme4::lmer(), nlme::gls() or nlme::lme().

use_coefs

Logical. If TRUE, substitute the estimates for the symbols (fixed effects, standard deviations of the random effects and residuals, variance function and correlation parameters). Default is FALSE.

coef_digits

Number of decimal places for the estimates. Default is 3.

...

Not used.

pair

For method_convert() results with bias = "linear": two method names to show the regression for one pair only. Default is NULL (all pairs).

Value

A character string of class c("model_equation", "character") with the LaTeX code (without math delimiters).

Details

The equation is returned as LaTeX code. Printed at the console it shows the code; in an R Markdown or Quarto document, a chunk that returns it renders the equation as display math. Equations with more than one line use an aligned environment: the mean model first, then the distributions.

Parameters that differ by a level (e.g., the method means \(\alpha_m\) or the ratios \(\delta\) of a variance function) are written with an index in the equation; with use_coefs = TRUE their estimates are listed at the end of the line.

The notation follows the vignettes:

  • tolerance_limit(): \(d_{ij}\) is the difference for subject \(i\), measurement \(j\), with the fixed effects, the random intercepts (model = "lme"), and the variance function and correlation structure of the fitted nlme model. Conditions are indicators \(\mathrm{I}(\cdot)\) and \(A\) is the average of the two measurements. The model must have been kept (keep_model = TRUE).

  • icc_test(), reli_err_test(), mdc_test(), reli_stats(), reli_aov(): \(y_{ij} = \mu + s_i + t_j + e_{ij}\) (one-way: without \(t_j\)). The same model underlies the consistency and agreement forms; the consistency forms do not use \(\sigma^2_t\).

  • reli_facet_test(): an effect for subjects (\(p\)), items (\(i\)), occasions (\(o\)) and their interactions, and repeat error \(e\).

  • method_vc(): \(y_{mir} = \alpha_m + \mu_i + a_{ir} + c_{mi} + e_{mir}\) for method \(m\), item \(i\), replicate \(r\), on the analysis scale of the transformation, with the designs without replicates as special cases.

  • method_convert(): the regression of the differences \(D\) on the averages \(A\) for each pair (bias = "linear"), the scaled model \(y_{mir} = \alpha_m + \beta_m(\mu_i + a_{ir} + c_{mi}) + e_{mir}\) (bias = "scaled"), or the variance component model (from a method_vc() result).

For lm, lmerMod, gls and lme models, the fixed effects are \(\beta_0, \beta_1, \ldots\), factor levels are indicators, and a factor with many levels is shown as one indexed effect \(\gamma\). Random effects are \(u\), \(v\), ... for the grouping factors, indexed \(j[i]\), \(k[i]\), ... (the group of observation \(i\)). The variance functions varIdent, varPower, varExp and varFixed, and the correlation structures corCompSymm, corAR1 and corCAR1 are written out; others are shown generically. Generalized linear models are not supported.

See also

tolerance_limit(), icc_test(), method_vc(), method_convert()

Examples

data('reps')
tl = tolerance_limit(data = reps, x = "x", y = "y", id = "id")
model_equation(tl)
#> \begin{aligned}
#> d_{ij} &= \beta_{0} + e_{ij} \\
#> e_{ij} &\sim N(0,\, \sigma^{2}) \\
#> \operatorname{Cor}(e_{ij}, e_{ij'}) &= \rho, \quad j \neq j' \\
#> & \text{where } d_{ij} = \mathrm{x}_{ij} - \mathrm{y}_{ij}
#> \end{aligned}
model_equation(tl, use_coefs = TRUE)
#> \begin{aligned}
#> d_{ij} &= 0.705 + e_{ij} \\
#> e_{ij} &\sim N(0,\, 1.458^{2}) \\
#> \operatorname{Cor}(e_{ij}, e_{ij'}) &= 0.928, \quad j \neq j' \\
#> & \text{where } d_{ij} = \mathrm{x}_{ij} - \mathrm{y}_{ij}
#> \end{aligned}

fit = lm(mpg ~ wt + factor(cyl), data = mtcars)
model_equation(fit, use_coefs = TRUE, coef_digits = 2)
#> \begin{aligned}
#> \mathrm{mpg}_{i} &= 33.99 - 3.21\,\mathrm{wt}_{i} - 4.26\,\mathrm{I}(\mathrm{cyl}_{i} = \mathrm{6}) - 6.07\,\mathrm{I}(\mathrm{cyl}_{i} = \mathrm{8}) + \varepsilon_{i} \\
#> \varepsilon_{i} &\sim N(0,\, 2.56^{2})
#> \end{aligned}
